scope: First acceptance unit only: a pure module that reduces real solveElastic results into axial reaction, gauge extension and engineering stress/strain, plus a revisioned independent-linear-solve step table. Static graph UI, API, MCP, CSV, history persistence, nonlinear hysteresis and the parent task remain out of scope.
changedFilesHashBasis: sha256 of the committed blob bytes (LF line endings)

src/module-layers.json.change: one line: register increment-curve-data.js in the domain layer (mayImport contract)

environment.dependencyInstall: npm ci in the dedicated worktree (22 packages)
environment.gmshWasmArtifact: node_modules/@loumalouomega/gmsh-wasm 0.3.0 present; real Gmsh WASM meshing and real solveElastic CPU solves were executed, no mock

fixture.origin: synthetic; the same reference bar already used by tests/elastic.test.mjs, not a measured specimen
fixture.geometryMm: box 10 x 10 x 40 (bounds 0,0,0,10,10,40), mesh size 4 mm
fixture.gauge: gauge a = equally weighted fixed-face nodes, gauge b = equally weighted loaded-face nodes (explicit weights summing to 1)
fixture.boundary: area-weighted traction on the loaded face triangles, driven through loadedFaceTractionForces from the same declared axis and loaded nodes, so the total applied axial force equals the requested force
fixture.solve: six independent solveElastic CPU solves (no load history, no display scaling)

expected.definitions: engineeringStressPa = tensileForceN / (initialAreaMm2 * 1e-6); engineeringStrain = extensionMm / initialGaugeLengthMm; tensileForceN = -(sum of support reaction projected on the axis) so tension is positive; no true stress/strain is emitted

measured.method: same synthetic spec and route as the test file, printed from a throwaway script outside the repository

return50N.note: rows 2 and 4 are two separate solves of the same route point; both 0.02000000000008617 mm. This linear round trip is on one straight route and is not claimed as plastic hysteresis.

revisions.scheme: existing project revision functions only: getProjectRevision(canonicalJson) for spec.input and getPhysicalRevision for each step result; no hand-written hash strings

rejectionsVerifiedByTest: duplicated or out-of-range fixed/loaded node id
a loaded node that is also fixed
gauge weights not summing to 1, wrong weight count, duplicated gauge node, gauge points sharing a node
incomplete rowIdentity or unsupported schema version
duplicated step id, non-boolean converged/provisional, unknown controlledQuantity, non-finite controlledValue, converged step without its result
rows mixing a different materialKey, geometryKey or gaugeKey
axial reaction that does not balance the applied load within 1e-5 N
result carrying plasticity history or hyperelastic state (a J2 result is not accepted as a step)
result exposing only maxVonMisesPa/maxDisplacementMm (no gauge or reaction data)
result without constraint reactions or with a non-finite displacement
no fallback that substitutes a maximum value for the gauge stress/strain

node --test tests/module-boundaries.test.reason: verify the new src module is registered exactly once in the domain layer

npm run check:contracts.result: Contract declarations type-check (5 declaration files). exit 0

notVerified: GUI, HTTP API and MCP exposure of the step table
CSV/JSON/image export and case history persistence (next unit)
load-unload hysteresis: only independent linear solves exist; plasticity history rows do not carry per-step displacement or reactions
non-uniform bar mesh convergence of the gauge averages (single synthetic mesh only)
real browser verification (not required for this unit)
parent RESULTCURVE1 acceptance (GUI/API/MCP/save-restore agreement, LLM reconstruction of the curve) is untouched
